about_the_game:
This is Your Mission

Iceburg is a thrilling third-person, single-player shooter that blends intense action with atmospheric exploration and puzzle-solving. Join a team of elite explorers on a daring expedition to Antarctica, where an abandoned Nazi military base harbors horrifying secrets beneath the ice. Face waves of mutated zombies, rogue robots, and advanced wartime technologies as you uncover a forgotten chapter of history that could threaten the future of humanity.

Whether you're gunning down enemies with a plasma rifle or solving cryptic mechanisms in a frozen control room, every moment in Iceburg delivers high-stakes, cooperative gameplay that demands quick reflexes and clever teamwork.

Survive the Ice

Antarctica isn’t just a backdrop—it’s a hostile character of its own. Navigate dynamic weather conditions like blizzards, whiteouts, and freezing temperatures that affect visibility and player stats. Use heat sources, thermal suits, and smart resource management to survive the relentless cold as you traverse frozen tundras, shattered research facilities, and cavernous ice tunnels deep underground.

Arsenal

From classic firearms to experimental energy weapons, Iceburg features an expansive arsenal designed to combat a variety of deadly threats. Take down swarming undead troops, mechanized war drones, and biomechanical monstrosities created in long-lost experiments. Upgrade your gear, customize your loadout, and sync with your squad to dominate in strategic firefights.

Solve the Mystery

Between battles, players will need to put their minds to the test. Ancient codes, cryptic blueprints, and rusted control panels guard the secrets of the underground base. Work together to solve multi-stage puzzles, hack into sealed chambers, and uncover audio logs and hidden documents that reveal the base’s twisted legacy—and its dangerous implications for the modern world.

Explore the Depths

The world of Iceburg is rich in narrative and environmental storytelling. Discover massive underground hangars, cryogenic labs, bio-engineering test chambers, and cold-war era bunkers—all interconnected by icy corridors and hidden entrances. Clues to the central mystery are scattered throughout, waiting to be pieced together by brave explorers.

The Threat Beneath

What begins as a simple expedition quickly spirals into a fight for global survival. The deeper you go, the stranger—and more dangerous—the discoveries become. A final showdown looms in the darkest heart of the base, where science, war, and horror converge.

Action, puzzles, the ability to switch between characters.

Will you and your team survive the Iceburg?
